title: Boeing F-15EX St. Louis production line: Phase 56K Exact-Record Decision
summary: The receiving unit states that Portland Air National Guard Base received F-15EX tail number 16 on December 11, 2025. This independently fixes the realized receiving-unit date after the production restart. Phase 56K decision: Retain Partially Closed. The exact receipt date advances the delivery rail, but the record does not provide the formal government acceptance date, monthly due-versus-accepted denominator, quality, rework, cost, or schedule variance.
key_findings: Named record: Realized post-restart delivery and acceptance dates.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when the Air Force, DCMA, or program office publishes the formal acceptance record or a monthly due-versus-accepted series.
why_it_matters: The decision records an exact acquisition result, including a verified non-closure, without substituting an adjacent record.
ftfn_relevance: Separates current record status from entity performance.
Keeps denominator, attribution, limitation, and reopening rule attached.
evidence_limits: A receiving-unit arrival date is realized delivery evidence but is not, by itself, the formal contractual acceptance date or a complete production-performance series.
Formal acceptance date, monthly due and accepted aircraft, schedule variance, rework, quality escapes, labor input, and unit cost.
No causal effect, entity ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
